data.title: Principal Product Manager, Fraud & Safety
data.description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is changing the way the world builds and secures software, and we want you to help build GitHub. Millions of developers and companies use GitHub to build, ship, and maintain their software. This role helps make it fast to ship products safely by anticipating fraud, abuse, and user-safety risks during product design and integrating proven controls before launch. 

 

We are looking for an experienced individual-contributor Product Manager to help define the vision, product strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for fraud prevention and Safety-by-Design capabilities across GitHub. You will partner closely with product, engineering, design, data science, product security, legal, privacy, trust and safety, and business teams to turn recurring abuse patterns into shared product capabilities.
data.qualifications:
Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years experience in product/service/project/program management, software
    development, product design, or related field
    • OR Bachelor's Degree in related field AND 8+ years experience in
      product/service/project/program management, software development,
      product design, or related field
    • OR equivalent experience.

  • 3+ years of experience owning product strategy, roadmaps, or launches for fraud prevention, abuse prevention, trust and safety, product integrity, security, or another adversarial-risk domain.
data.responsibilities:
• Define and own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and success measures for GitHub fraud prevention and Safety-by-Design investments, connecting customer trust, platform integrity, product growth, and business risk reduction.

  • Create and deliver a vision for fraud identification, protection, abuse prevention, and product safety controls that aligns customer needs with GitHub’s goals.

Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is changing the way the world builds and secures software. Data helps us understand how developers and organizations use our products, make better decisions, and deliver experiences our customers can trust. 

 

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to define and drive a connected product strategy for data across GitHub: trusted internal data products and platform capabilities; product measurement and experimentation; and the data foundations that support customer-facing insights. You will work with the Metrics and Insights PM and partners across product, engineering, data, design, security, privacy, and business teams to turn complex data needs into products with measurable impact.
